\section*{Tight-Binding Hamiltonian}

The real-space matrix elements define

\begin{equation}
  H(\mathbf{k}) = \sum_{\mathbf{R}} e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot\mathbf{R}}\, H(\mathbf{R}),
\end{equation}

where $\mathbf{k}$ is given in reduced coordinates and $H_{mn}(\mathbf{R}) = \langle \mathbf{0}m | \hat{H} | \mathbf{R}n \rangle$.

The direct-lattice basis vectors used in $\mathbf{R} = R_1\mathbf{a}_1 + R_2\mathbf{a}_2 + R_3\mathbf{a}_3$ are

\begin{align}
  \mathbf{a}_1 &= (3.01435, -5.221, 0) \\
  \mathbf{a}_2 &= (3.01435, 5.221, 0) \\
  \mathbf{a}_3 &= (0, 0, 23)
\end{align}

\subsection*{Second-quantization form}

The Hamiltonian in second-quantization reads

\begin{equation}
  H = \sum_{\mathbf{k}} \sum_{m,n} H_{mn}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{m\mathbf{k}} c_{n\mathbf{k}},
\end{equation}

where $H_{mn}(\mathbf{k}) = \sum_{\mathbf{R}} H_{mn}(\mathbf{R})\, e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot\mathbf{R}}$.

Expanded term by term (orbital labels: $\text{P1:}d_{xz}$, $\text{P1:}d_{yz}$, $\text{P2:}d_{xz}$, $\text{P2:}d_{yz}$):

\begin{align}
H &= \sum_{\mathbf{k}} \Bigl[
      \varepsilon_{\text{P1:}d_{xz}}\, c^\dagger_{\text{P1:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P1:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}}
    +   \varepsilon_{\text{P1:}d_{yz}}\, c^\dagger_{\text{P1:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P1:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   \varepsilon_{\text{P2:}d_{xz}}\, c^\dagger_{\text{P2:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P2:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}}
    +   \varepsilon_{\text{P2:}d_{yz}}\, c^\dagger_{\text{P2:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P2:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   f_{\text{P1:}d_{xz} \to \text{P1:}d_{yz}}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P1:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P1:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}}
    +   f_{\text{P1:}d_{xz} \to \text{P1:}d_{yz}}^*(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P1:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P1:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   f_{\text{P1:}d_{xz} \to \text{P2:}d_{xz}}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P1:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P2:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}}
    +   f_{\text{P1:}d_{xz} \to \text{P2:}d_{xz}}^*(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P2:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P1:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   f_{\text{P1:}d_{xz} \to \text{P2:}d_{yz}}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P1:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P2:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}}
    +   f_{\text{P1:}d_{xz} \to \text{P2:}d_{yz}}^*(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P2:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P1:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   f_{\text{P1:}d_{yz} \to \text{P2:}d_{xz}}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P1:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P2:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}}
    +   f_{\text{P1:}d_{yz} \to \text{P2:}d_{xz}}^*(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P2:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P1:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   f_{\text{P1:}d_{yz} \to \text{P2:}d_{yz}}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P1:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P2:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}}
    +   f_{\text{P1:}d_{yz} \to \text{P2:}d_{yz}}^*(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P2:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P1:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   f_{\text{P2:}d_{xz} \to \text{P2:}d_{yz}}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P2:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P2:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}}
    +   f_{\text{P2:}d_{xz} \to \text{P2:}d_{yz}}^*(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{P2:}d_{yz},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{P2:}d_{xz},\mathbf{k}}
  \Bigr],
\end{align}

where the on-site energies are

\begin{align}
  \varepsilon_{\text{P1:}d_{xz}} &= \operatorname{Re}[H_{\text{P1:}d_{xz},\text{P1:}d_{xz}}(\mathbf{0})] = -4.04203\text{ eV} \\
  \varepsilon_{\text{P1:}d_{yz}} &= \operatorname{Re}[H_{\text{P1:}d_{yz},\text{P1:}d_{yz}}(\mathbf{0})] = -4.04262\text{ eV} \\
  \varepsilon_{\text{P2:}d_{xz}} &= \operatorname{Re}[H_{\text{P2:}d_{xz},\text{P2:}d_{xz}}(\mathbf{0})] = -4.04203\text{ eV} \\
  \varepsilon_{\text{P2:}d_{yz}} &= \operatorname{Re}[H_{\text{P2:}d_{yz},\text{P2:}d_{yz}}(\mathbf{0})] = -4.04262\text{ eV}
\end{align}

The structure functions are defined as

\begin{align}
  f_{\text{P1:}d_{xz} \to \text{P1:}d_{yz}}(\mathbf{k}) &= -0.015339\, \\
  f_{\text{P1:}d_{xz} \to \text{P2:}d_{xz}}(\mathbf{k}) &= -0.082235\,
    + 0.037878\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(\mathbf{a}_1)}
    + 0.032117\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(-\mathbf{a}_2)} \\
  f_{\text{P1:}d_{xz} \to \text{P2:}d_{yz}}(\mathbf{k}) &= 0.168186\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(-\mathbf{a}_2)}
    - 0.024001\,
    - 0.022112\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(\mathbf{a}_1)} \\
  f_{\text{P1:}d_{yz} \to \text{P2:}d_{xz}}(\mathbf{k}) &= 0.168186\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(-\mathbf{a}_2)}
    - 0.024001\,
    - 0.022112\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(\mathbf{a}_1)} \\
  f_{\text{P1:}d_{yz} \to \text{P2:}d_{yz}}(\mathbf{k}) &= -0.083117\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(\mathbf{a}_1)}
    + 0.040589\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(-\mathbf{a}_2)}
    + 0.034953\, \\
  f_{\text{P2:}d_{xz} \to \text{P2:}d_{yz}}(\mathbf{k}) &= -0.015339\,
\end{align}
